hypotheses: H1: The first line A375 yields a recorded active for each compound due to broad transferable perturbation signatures; a second line will yield inactive if its baseline or tissue context does not meet the vehicle-norm activity threshold.

H2: The first line A375 yields a recorded active for each compound due to shared systematic response or assay artifacts; a second line will yield inactive if it lacks the same systematic response, independent of compound-specific mechanism.
evidence_gaps: No measured activity labels for any compound-line pair are provided.
No evidence that target expression or pathway dependence differs across the available lines.
No information on vehicle-norm thresholds or L1000 activity calls for these compounds.
No causal link between listed targets/MOA and activity in A375 or any second line.
No data on whether A375 activity is driven by transferable perturbation or shared systematic response.
